tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Laxmi India Finance Limited has filed its ITR u/s 139(1) which was selected for scrutiny vide order dated September 27, 2022. AO issued notice u/s 154 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 to disallow claim of INR 34,36,075 u/s 80JJAA leading to tax liability of 8,64,791. Laxmi India Finance Limited has filed appeal against this order on January 24, 2025. Further we have received hearing notice from department against which we have filed our submission.
tax_litigation.status: Income Tax Department has rejected the appeal filed on January 24,2025 by Laxmi India Finance Limited against which company has filed appeal in ITAT on January 19,2026.
